{{Quote|Be ''grateful'' for my guard globes, Corellian! They just ''prolonged'' you life&hellip;and ''everyone else's''!|Arakkus, to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Deadly Reunion" />}}
The '''guard-globe [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|seeker]] droid''', also known simply as the '''guard globe''', was a form of [[Remote/Legends|remote]] used by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Arakkus]] to protect his fortress in the [[Graveyard of Lost Ships]]. They patrolled corridors and were programmed to intercept intruders.
